note: Wyandot County has no queryable zoning district service found. County zoning is handled by the cities (Upper Sandusky, Carey, Sycamore) and the county planning commission; their zoning is published only as static JPG/PDF maps (Upper Sandusky 2021 PDF map, Carey and Sycamore JPG maps). The county GIS is a Schneider Beacon parcel viewer (parcels and ownership, not zoning) with no public REST service. Upper Sandusky's planning page links only a PDF map and names a zoning inspector for the map. Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online for Wyandot zoning found no service. Parcel fields for zoning are essentially empty per landrecords.us.
